title: •Ounee Ta
caption: •Ounee Ta (V)
game_text: Plays on table. At each opponent’s ◇ site, your Rebels are each deploy -2 and your Force generation is +1.
lore: Jabba’s decadent behavior makes him susceptible to deception. Leia and Lando exploited this weakness, posing as Jabba’s kind of scum.

notes: The white diamond ◇ (non-unique-location mark) is typed as U+25C7; the wiki stub reads it as "system site" (differs) and the PDF text layer drops it. Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. "-2" printed with a hyphen on the slip (the printed card has "−3"). Heading and caption •Ounee Ta (V), dots match the base. Lore corrected: curly apostrophes in Jabba’s (twice; wiki straight). Copyright: SE-style line on the 350 px scan, year unclear — read as 2000 (Jabba’s Palace Sealed Deck, Oct 2000), consistent with vs6/20 (another JPSD base). NB the brief suggested 1998; the scan’s form (no year before LUCASFILM) is the SE/2000-era line. Modern file VSh-L-ouneeta-pre.gif is a later PC shield (Ref III) with DIFFERENT text — art reference only. Art from the base scan, not the modern VSh shield face: the shield frame's art window is narrower and left a cyan strip down the right edge of the art box.
